title: DraftReply
description: Output of agents/draft_agent.py. Every field is required so post-hoc validation is unambiguous; the agent is forbidden from emitting partials.

thread_id.description: Thread the draft replies into. Must match the input payload's thread_id.

in_reply_to_message_id.description: The message_id this reply targets. NULL only for first-message threads (rare).

to_emails.description: Primary recipients. Default: the most recent non-user message's from_email.

subject.description: If replying, prefix with 'Re: ' unless the existing subject already starts with one.

body.description: Plain-text reply body. No HTML. End with the user's preferred sign-off if known.

rationale.description: 1-3 sentences explaining what facts informed this draft and why this tone.

cited_facts.description: Each cited fact ties claims in the draft back to source messages. fact_id is a free-form short label (e.g. 'thursday_2pm_proposal'); source_message_ids must exist in the input thread.

confidence.description: high = ready to send, medium = review, low = surface for human guidance only.
